cases.subject: Joint tender workshop - could your assistant set it up?
cases.body:
Dear Wiktor,

Thank you for the productive call last week. Both teams now agree that the joint tender for the northern retail chain needs a full working day in one room before we submit anything. I suggest Gdansk, since most of your pricing people sit there.

Could you ask your assistant, Dorota Wilczynska, to find a day in the week of 25 January when your calendar and the meeting room allow it? She can propose two or three options to my office. We will bring four people from the Baltic Freight Partners side, including our lawyer, and we need a working lunch for all of them.

You do not need to join the planning itself. A short note from Dorota with the proposed dates is enough, and my assistant will confirm the same day.

Many thanks for your help with this.

Kind regards | Daniel Hargreaves | Managing Partner | Baltic Freight Partners

cases.subject: Customs briefing for the export team - scheduling
cases.body:
Dear Wiktor,

Our customs specialist will visit Gdansk in the last week of January, and I would like to use the trip for a short briefing for your export team. The new transit rules for the Baltic ports affect all your Nordic lanes, so it is worth an hour of their time.

Could you ask your team to arrange this? In practice someone should check the calendars of Oliver Pemberton and the two export coordinators, book a meeting room with a projector and add the invitation to your shared calendar. If it fits better, a late afternoon slot is fine for us.

Dorota Wilczynska would know how your booking system works, so she seems the natural person. A short confirmation of the date to my office is all I need. I will send the slides one day before the session.

Thank you for your support.

Kind regards | Daniel Hargreaves | Managing Partner | Baltic Freight Partners

cases.subject: Board meeting logistics
cases.body:
Wiktor,

Let's make the January board meeting run smoothly this time. Could you ask Dorota to take care of the logistics? She should book the large meeting room for the full morning, order coffee and lunch for nine people and print ten copies of the budget pack that your finance team sends by Monday.

The auditors will join us for the second part, so please make sure they get visitor passes at the reception. I do not need to see the arrangements in advance.

Thanks for taking care of it.

cases.body:
Dear Mr Szalewski,

The December statement for your fleet cards is ready, and our system shows three transactions with a different price per litre than the one agreed in the contract. The difference is small, but it should be settled before the next invoice run.

Could you ask your accounting team to compare the statement with their own records and to confirm which of the three transactions they accept? Magdalena Czerniak already knows our billing format. If she agrees with our numbers, we will issue the corrected invoice immediately.

This is a routine matter, so a reply from the accounting side is perfectly fine.

cases.subject: Board budget pack - status of preparations
cases.body:
Dear Mr Szalewski,

I write to inform you about the state of preparations for the supervisory board meeting on 28 January. The audit committee has completed its review of the draft annual budget and will present its findings during the first hour. The committee found no material objections to the revenue assumptions, but it recommends that the board discusses the fuel cost scenario separately, since the supplier contracts will be renegotiated in the spring.

The agenda has been fixed in the form circulated earlier. The first part covers the budget and the report of the audit committee, the second part covers the joint tender with the freight partner, and the third part covers staffing of the new warehouses. Two board members will take part by video link and the secretary has confirmed the technical arrangements with the company's IT department.

The auditors will attend the second part of the meeting, as agreed last year. The minutes of the previous meeting have been approved in writing by all members and require no further steps. I mention this only for the record.

I also wish to note that the chairman's report to the shareholders will be shortened this year at the request of the committee. The full text will remain available to all members in the board portal after the meeting.

Respectfully,
Zbigniew Orlowicz

cases.subject: Wspólne przetargi - stan na koniec tygodnia
cases.body:
Szanowny Panie Wiktorze,

chciałbym przekazać krótką informację o stanie naszych wspólnych ofert przetargowych. Wszystkie trzy postępowania, w których startujemy razem, są obecnie na etapie uzupełniania dokumentacji. Nasz zespół zakończył przygotowanie zestawień kosztów tras oraz tłumaczeń przysięgłych, a Państwa dział sprzedaży przekazał nam komplet cenników, za co dziękuję. Spójność liczb sprawdził nasz kontroler finansowy i nie znalazł rozbieżności większych niż jedna dziesiąta procenta.

W przetargu dla sieci hurtowni zamawiający przesunął termin zadawania pytań o kilka dni, co daje nam więcej czasu na dopracowanie harmonogramu dostaw. W drugim postępowaniu, dotyczącym transportu towarów chłodzonych, komisja przetargowa opublikowała wyniki oceny formalnej i obie nasze oferty zostały dopuszczone do dalszego etapu. Trzecie postępowanie jest dopiero w fazie wstępnej, a zamawiający zapowiedział publikację pełnych warunków na początku lutego.

Z naszej strony wszystko przebiega zgodnie z planem. Wiadomość ma charakter informacyjny, nie wymaga Pańskiej odpowiedzi ani decyzji. Kolejne podsumowanie przekażę w przyszłym tygodniu, jeśli pojawią się jakiekolwiek zmiany po stronie zamawiających. Cieszę się z dobrej współpracy naszych zespołów, która w tych postępowaniach naprawdę procentuje.

Z wyrazami szacunku

Logistyka Dziś, wydanie piątkowe

Ceny oleju napędowego na stacjach w Polsce spadły w tym tygodniu o trzy grosze na litrze, według cotygodniowego zestawienia rynkowego. Spadek wynika głównie z niższych notowań hurtowych na początku miesiąca.

Dostawcy kart flotowych zapowiadają od lutego zmiany w opłatach za obsługę kont. Większość firm zachowa dotychczasowe zasady dla klientów z dużymi flotami, a nowe stawki dotkną głównie małych przewoźników. Branża spodziewa się, że rabaty wolumenowe zostaną zachowane.

W kolejnym numerze: regulacje dotyczące opłat drogowych oraz przegląd przetargów na transport w regionie.

cases.body:
Dear Mr Szalewski,

I would like to share a short status. Our warehouse in Gothenburg has confirmed the delivery windows for February: Tuesdays and Thursdays between 08:00 and 12:00, with a reserve window on Fridays. These windows replace the January schedule, which was only a provisional arrangement.

The certificates for the chilled pallets have been renewed and our quality department found them complete. The first shipment under the new schedule will arrive in the second week of February. We have also informed our carriers about the changed windows.

This is for your records and requires no action from your side.

Best regards | Karin Lindqvist | Procurement Lead | Nordic Foods Trade

cases.subject: Customs rules for Nordic exports - short summary
cases.body:
Dear Mr Szalewski,

I would like to pass on the summary of the new customs procedure for food exports to the Nordic countries that our compliance team prepared this week. From 1 February, electronic pre-notification is mandatory for chilled and frozen goods. Our importer accounts are already registered in the new system, so the change does not affect the clearance time of your shipments.

The Swedish authorities have confirmed that existing certificates remain valid until their expiry date. Hand-written certificates will no longer be accepted at the border. We have checked the paperwork of the last three shipments and found it consistent with the new rules.

Best regards on this, and thank you for the smooth cooperation so far.

Best regards | Karin Lindqvist | Procurement Lead | Nordic Foods Trade

cases.subject: FYI - Hamburg lane update
cases.body:
Wiktor,

just a heads up on the Hamburg lane: the border queue this week is much shorter than in December, mostly 2-3 hours for trucks with pre-notification. The two delayed loads from last Friday arrived Monday morning, all docs fine. Customs did random checks on about one in five trucks but found nothing.

I will keep tracking it and let you know if the picture changes. Nothing needed from you for now.

Oliver

Nie trzeba nic robić, informuję tylko, żebyś miał obraz sytuacji. Kolejną informację dostaniesz po zakończeniu rozmów w Gdyni.
